newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy mini-budget presented by Easter - cabinet.
newsitem.headline: Italy mini-budget presented by Easter - cabinet.

text.p: The Italian government will unveil its planned mini-budget before the end of the month and will probably publish state accounts from the first quarter later this week, cabinet secretary Enrico Micheli told reporters.
"We will do the budget by Easter," said Micheli. Easter Sunday falls on March 30.
"The quarterly accounts are practically ready and should be presented this week," he added.
Treasury sources indicated early this month that the budget package was expected to include between 14-15 trillion lire of deficit-cutting measures.

Prime Minister Romano Prodi has said a mini-budget is needed to tame an expected overshoot in 1997 accounts and ensure Italy meets the criteria laid down in the Maastricht Treaty for countries wishing to sign up to the single European currency. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
